comparison.objective: Replace two failed/predictive-failure drives in an order that preserves a RAID array.
comparison.physical_skill: Extract and insert drives, monitor a rebuild lamp, wait, then replace the second drive.
comparison.success_condition: Failed drive is replaced first; the amber drive is not removed until an eight-second rebuild completes and the lamp turns green.
comparison.reason: This tests ordered hot-swap insertion and system-state waiting, not fine rotary adjustment and repeated impact validation.
